summary: The diff implements most of the required chunked upload/retrieval system. REQ-10 (backend), REQ-11 (frontend upload), and REQ-13 (hooks) are largely addressed. However, REQ-12 (ViewerPage chunked retrieval) is not fully implemented — the ViewerPage still uses the ExternalBlob direct URL approach via XHR rather than the new getPdfChunks/getPdfChunk chunked retrieval API. Additionally, REQ-13 requires removal of old single-call upload/fetch API references, but useGetPdf still references the old API. The backend renamePdf function appears to be exposed as updatePdfTitle rather than renamePdf as specified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Rewrite ViewerPage.tsx to use getPdfChunks(shareId) to get chunk count, then getPdfChunk(shareId, chunkIndex) to fetch each chunk sequentially, reassemble into a Blob, and create an object URL for the iframe.
missing_requirements.reason: The ViewerPage diff shows it still fetches the PDF via pdf.file.getDirectURL() and XHR download — it does not call getPdfChunks or getPdfChunk from the backend. The chunked retrieval API is not used in ViewerPage.

missing_requirements.requirement: Expose backend function renamePdf(shareId, newTitle) as specified.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend function is named updatePdfTitle in useQueries.ts (useUpdatePdfTitle calls actor.updatePdfTitle), suggesting the backend exposes updatePdfTitle rather than renamePdf as specified in REQ-10.

missing_requirements.requirement: useQueries.ts should expose hooks for chunked retrieval (getPdfChunks, getPdfChunk).
missing_requirements.reason: The useQueries.ts diff does not show any hooks named useGetPdfChunks or useGetPdfChunk. No chunked retrieval hooks are exposed, only useGetPdf which calls actor.getPdf.

missing_requirements.requirement: No references to the old single-call upload/fetch API should remain in useQueries.ts.
missing_requirements.reason: useQueries.ts still contains useGetPdf which calls actor.getPdf — this appears to be the old single-call fetch API. The requirement states no references to old single-call upload/fetch API should remain.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration module (backend/migration.mo) was added to handle data migration from old storage format to new chunked format.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not mention or request a migration module. While this may be a reasonable implementation detail, it was not specified in any requirement.

hallucinated_features.description: finalizeUpload in useQueries.ts accepts a fileBytes parameter and uses ExternalBlob.fromBytes with upload progress for storing the actual PDF binary, rather than simply calling a no-argument finalizeUpload(shareId).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-10 specifies finalizeUpload(shareId) as the backend function signature. The frontend hook wraps this with blob upload logic that was not explicitly specified in the requirements.
